# Venue memo

Best fit: a concise mathematical-physics or computational-analysis journal
that welcomes explicit estimates and reproducible proof certificates.

Candidate profiles: *Journal of Mathematical Physics*, *Letters in
Mathematical Physics*, or a computer-assisted proof venue after strengthening
the interval-sharpness comparison. The current 13-page format is suited to a
technical note. A specialist lattice journal would require a more substantial
interacting-measure application.
